prerequisites: Knowledge in Graphic Expression at the level of the contents of the subjects Graphic Expression and Assisted Design from the first year and Mechanical Graphic Engineering or Industrial Graphic Engineering from the second year.

The student must be proficient in the precise language for representing a specific idea, object, part or machine, a three-dimensional reality, in a solely two-dimensional system such as paper or a computer screen.
They must master the commonly accepted rules and standards used in any industrial drawing, from a mechanical engineer's point of view, both concerning graphic and technological information.

They will need to master aspects related to the definition of parts and mechanisms so that their configuration and dimensions are perfectly defined and unequivocally interpreted by all people involved in the subsequent production process.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and capacities to apply the scientific and technological fundamentals of solid modeling.

syllabus_topics: UD1. Solid modeling with parametric and variational systems
UD2. Surface modeling and adaptive modeling
teaching_methods: UNED methodology with in-person or remote tutoring by tutors
assessment_rules: The overall course grade is the sum of partial qualifications obtained in different tests and exercises. The written examination (Prueba Presencial) contributes 80% to the final grade and has two calls (February and September). Continuous assessment tests (PEC) contribute 10% to the final grade. Mandatory practical work contributes 10% to the final grade; practical sessions are obligatory, and non-attendance prevents passing the course. To sum the scores from continuous assessment and practical work to the written examination score, a minimum of 4 points must be obtained in the examination, and attendance to practical work is required.
institution: Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia
